jobs.title: User Experience Researcher
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

The User Experience Researcher is responsible for understanding customer behaviors, needs, motivations, and barriers to help shape intuitive, accessible, and engaging customer experiences. This position conducts qualitative and quantitative research and translates findings into actionable recommendations that inform program, product, service, and technology decisions.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end customer and user experience research studies using appropriate qualitative and quantitative methodologies.
* Develop research plans, objectives, methodologies, participant criteria, interview guides, and support research materials.
* Conduct interviews, focus groups, contextual inquiries, usability studies, surveys, and other research activities.
* Moderate remote and in-person research sessions and conduct field-based research, as appropriate.
* Partner with stakeholders to define research questions, project scope, prototypes, and testing approaches.
* Analyze and synthesize research findings to identify customer needs, behaviors, pain points, barriers, and opportunities for improvement.
* Evaluate accessibility, language, health-literacy, cultural, and other factors that may affect customer experience.
* Develop customer personas, journey maps, and other research artifacts to communicate customer needs and experiences.
* Facilitate or support customer journey-mapping workshops with project partners and cross-functional teams.
* Integrate research findings with operational and customer-experience data to identify trends and improvement opportunities.
* Develop reports and presentations that clearly communicate research findings, insights, and recommended actions.
* Present findings and recommendations to project leadership, State stakeholders, and other appropriate audiences.
* Collaborate with Customer Experience, Quality Assurance, Operations, IT, Product, and other cross-functional partners to incorporate research findings into program improvements.
* Recommend improvements to products, services, processes, and customer interactions based on research findings.
* Maintain research activities within established project scope, schedule, and budget.
* Remain current on customer experience, user experience, accessibility, and research best practices.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human-Computer Interaction, psychology, anthropology, behavioral science, or a related field preferred.
* Three or more years of customer experience research, user experience research, or related experience preferred.
* Demonstrated knowledge of qualitative and quantitative research methodologies.
* Experience conducting interviews, focus groups, usability testing, surveys, contextual inquiries, or similar research.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, facilitation, and presentation skills.
* Ability to synthesize complex research findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Familiarity with CX and UX research tools, journey mapping, personas, and data-analysis techniques preferred.
* Familiarity with accessibility, health literacy, and inclusive research practices preferred.
* Ability to manage multiple research initiatives in a fast-paced environment.

Pay: From $80,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Sacramento, CA 95814

---------------

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Do you want to shape the next generation of the Amazon Prime Video's content discovery and viewing experience? From one service, we're delivering versatile ways to watch hundreds of thousands of movies, TV series, and live events on the web, mobile, and TV. Our service is available in more than 200 territories globally, and we're just getting started.  
  
Working closely with business and technology partners, we use research, design, and prototyping to explore the frontier of generative AI and conversational experiences, guide early product development, and develop a customer-centric point of view.  
  
As a Conversational AI Product Design Technologist, you'll be a key part of our UX design organization. Your role will be all about proving, advancing, and evolving cutting-edge conversational experiences through prototyping and hands-on product work. You'll translate human conversational needs into AI interaction behaviors, and you'll build what you design, writing system instructions, shaping model behavior, building evaluations, and prototyping across platforms. We welcome candidates who come at this from design technology, UX research, linguistics, or IVR backgrounds, and we value a deep instinct for conversation paired with real AI fluency.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Build high-quality, functional prototypes that convey and advance the vision of future conversational experiences.

  

* Translate human conversational needs into AI interaction behaviors, balancing a natural and trustworthy voice.

  

* Shape model behavior by writing and refining system instructions and prompts, building goldens and platinums, and partnering on reinforcement learning and evaluations.

  

* Design and build for repair and recovery, handling ambiguity, misunderstanding, hallucination, and graceful failure.

  
-Define conversational quality metrics and apply them to measurably improve the experience, including building LLM-as-a-judge evaluations.  
  

* Prototype across voice, text, visual, and ambient (multimodal) surfaces, using the best and most appropriate tools for the task.

  

* Collaborate with design leadership and stakeholders throughout the product lifecycle, and work alongside designers, researchers, PMs, and engineers to drive concepts from idea to implementation.

  

* Thrive in a fast-paced, iterative environment with ambiguous challenges and brand new customer experiences.

  
A day in the life  
One moment you might be mapping how a conversation should recover when a customer is misunderstood, then writing the system instructions that get the model there and standing up an evaluation to measure whether it holds up. The next moment, you might be building an interactive prototype on AWS Bedrock to show partners and leadership what the experience feels like, directing the model the way a film director uses analogies rather than spot correcting, letting it apply its own reasoning and world knowledge to interpret intent. You will move fluidly between designing the experience, shaping the model, and coding the prototype that makes it real.

* 5+ years of front-end technologist, engineer, or UX prototyper experience

* Experience shaping AI systems, including writing system instructions and prompts and building or running evaluations.
* Experience building functional prototypes, for example with front-end technologies, AI prototyping tools, or AWS tools such as Bedrock.

* Background in UX Design, UX research, linguistics, computational linguistics, or IVR/voice design.

- Experience defining conversational quality metrics and running LLM evaluations, including LLM-as-a-judge.  

* Experience prototyping multimodal experiences across voice, text, visual, and ambient surfaces.
* Familiarity with prompt engineering, model shaping, reinforcement learning, and AI-driven personalization.
